dogecoin.text: There's a lot of talk about #dogecoin these days for obvious reasons (400% in a couple days etc.) But one of the big developments of the past few weeks was Grayscale's addition of 5 new assets to its trust offer, including Basic Attention Token, Chainlink, Decentraland, Filecoin.

*BREAKING*

The SEC delays decision on multiple spot #crypto ETFs including VanEck Solana ETF, Canary Solana ETF, Canary XRP ETF, Grayscale XRP ETF, Canary Litecoin ETF, and Grayscale Dogecoin ETF.

The “designated a longer period” may be due to application vol.
